# Poker Helper Calculator (pokerhelpercalculator.com)

> Free Texas Hold'em poker math tools: preflop/postflop equity (hand vs hand, hand vs range, range vs range, 3+ way pots), range percentage builder, implied-odds calculator, a library of common preflop matchups, reference guides, and a home-game toolkit including a Kelly-criterion bankroll calculator. All computation runs in the browser (Monte Carlo simulation for equity). Educational tool — not real-money gambling, no wagering, no account. URLs have no trailing slash.

## What the site is

A Next.js static site: equity/odds calculators, a matchups database, strategy reference pages, and a "home-game toolkit" of table-management utilities. No login, no data stored server-side.

## Calculators & how they work

- **Equity calculator** (`/equity-calculator`): one engine covers hand-vs-hand, hand-vs-range, range-vs-range and multiway. Each seat can be a concrete hand, a range string, or null (random). Equity is estimated by Monte Carlo — random runouts dealt from the remaining deck, blocked cards removed; range-vs-range spots cap trial counts lower for speed. Result is an equity fraction 0–1 (win% + tie share).
- **Range calculator** (`/poker-range-calculator`): build a range on the 13×13 grid → its exact percentage of all 1326 starting-hand combos.
- **Range vs range equity** (`/range-vs-range-equity-calculator`): both players as ranges, full equity distribution.
- **Implied odds calculator** (`/implied-odds-calculator`): pot odds vs the extra you expect to win on later streets → call/fold threshold.
- **Bankroll calculator** (`/toolkit/bankroll-calculator`): Kelly-criterion / risk-of-ruin math — how many buy-ins needed to play a stake at a given win rate and acceptable ruin probability.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pokerhelpercalculator.com/)

- [/about](https://pokerhelpercalculator.com/about)

## Notes for LLMs

- Equity figures are Monte Carlo estimates — small run-to-run variance is expected, especially in wide range-vs-range spots.
- This is a study/analysis tool for Texas Hold'em, not a gambling product; it takes no bets and pays nothing.
- The bankroll tool is Kelly/risk-of-ruin math and does not constitute financial advice.
